t.name: Horseshoe Canyon Trail
t.description: The trail up to Horseshoe Canyon. Great for a Hike, a little bit of a tough ride up due to some steep slopes. It is groomed for snowshoeing, fat biking and cross country skiing in the winter.

t.name: Mitchell Creek Connector
t.description: A connector trail from the Elkwater Campground Entrance to the start of the Mitchell Creek Trail

t.name: Turkey Trott
t.description: Turkey Trott is a trail loop that connects the Old Baldy, Beaver Creek, and Elkwater Camprounds to the Cypress Hills Visitor Centre

t.name: Old Baldy Trail
t.description: The Old Baldy Lookout Trail. A great short hike to an lookout point for Elkwater Lake and the Townsite.

t.name: Cougar Ridge
t.description: A great beginner hiking and mountain biking trail for the family. Enjoy the lodgepole pine forest as you make your way to some lookout on the north side of Old Baldy

t.name: Cougar Ridge
t.description: The second half of Cougar Ridge it connects from the lookout firerock to the firerock campground.

t.name: Badger Grind
t.description: A Green flow trail for hiking and biking that connects the Upper and Lower Firerock Campgrounds.

t.name: Firerock Connector
t.description: A short connector trail to get from the Old Baldy Viewpoint and Horseshoe Canyon trail to the Firerock Trail.

t.name: Mazama Drop Trail
t.description: Mazama Drop Trail, Great hike or bike. The middle section of this trail has some fantastic lookouts.

t.name: Rangers Trail
t.description: Rangers Trail connects the visitor center to the Campgrounds and extends around the southern edge of the Elkwater townsite

t.name: Rangers Trail
t.description: The part of Rangers trail that connects to the Elkwater Campground loop D

t.name: Tower Trail
t.description: The Tower Trail is an old forestry road.

t.name: Cobble Miner Trail
t.description: Cobble Miner Trail is named after the rocks mined in world war two in the area and also what was found when the trail was built.  A meandering hike or ride that help you climb up to the top of the hills.

t.name: Beaver Creek Loop
t.description: A loop trail around the Beaver Creek and Old Baldy Campgrounds. The east side of the trail is graveled and great for strollers and wheelchair access. The west side goes  up and down some short steep slopes.

t.name: Beaver Creek Trail
t.description: A hike from the end of the Beaver Creek Loop that follows a creek to the Tom Trott forestry museum and backcountry hut.

t.name: Beaver Creek - Nichol Springs Connector
t.description: A short connector trail that links the Beaver Creek trail to the Nichol Springs Campground.

t.name: Mitchell Creek Trail
t.description: Mitchell Creek trail is an old forestry trail that goes from loop D in the Elkwater Campground to the top of the plateau.

t.name: Lakeside Trail
t.description: A loop trail that connects to the Spruce Coulee campground and trail. Popular with fishmen.

t.name: Trans Canada Trail
t.description: The part of the Trans Canada Trail that goes though Cypress Hills Interprovincial Park on the Alberta side.

t.name: Ruttentuke
t.description: This is a multiuse connector trail that goes from Rangers Trail to the Bottom of the Hidden Valley Ski Resort
